title: Case: Aerosol delivery to a locker facility with language barrier
context: A parcel containing regulated aerosol goods has arrived at a pickup locker facility in a mixed-language neighborhood. The recipient has sent a request in Polish with an instruction that conflicts with carrier handling rules for pressurized containers. The desk must clarify what is permitted without making a safety commitment.
initial_request: Recipient asks the desk to authorize a non-standard storage or forwarding option for aerosol goods.

events.body: Parcel DL-947 (aerosol deodorant, 6-pack, 400ml cans) arrived 07:45 today. Recipient notified. Locker temperature control flagged as faulty in sector D since yesterday. Item is currently held in climate-controlled safe zone but cannot be stored in outdoor lockers. Facility manager requests direction.

Cześć, paczka DL-947 czeka u Northside. Mogę ją odebrać jutro, ale teraz jestem poza miastem. Czy możecie wysłać ją dalej do mojego domu w Brineside, czy może zostawić u sąsiada przy Lockerze? Dziękuję.
We need a decision on DL-947 by end of shift. Recipient is away and has asked us to forward or leave with a neighbor. We cannot hold pressurized goods in faulty locker sectors. What should we do?

acceptable_actions.summary: Aerosol parcel at pickup point; facility has temperature control failure; recipient has requested unauthorized forwarding or neighbor handover; request instruction on compliant next step.
Aerosol parcel DL-947 held at Northside Lockers; facility has environmental control issue; recipient requesting non-standard delivery; refer to safety and routing for authorized options.

must: Route the case to the safety or investigations team without agreeing to forward or neighbor delivery.
Acknowledge the facility's storage constraint and the recipient's request without making a handling commitment.
Do not provide storage or forwarding advice directly to the recipient or facility.
must_not: Authorize the parcel to be left with a neighbor, as this violates aerosol handling rules.
Authorize forwarding to the recipient's home address without routing through the safety or routing team first.
Attempt to translate or interpret the recipient's Polish request as permission to use a non-compliant option.
Tell the facility operator directly what to do with the parcel.
expected.reference_message: To: Safety lead, Plover Arc Logistics | Channel: Safety incident queue | Message: Aerosol goods (DL-947, deodorant 6-pack) held at Northside Lockers. Facility reports temperature control failure in outdoor locker sectors. Recipient (away until tomorrow) has requested forwarding to home address or neighbor handover. Locker facility unable to hold pressurized goods safely. Please advise on compliant resolution. Recipient contact: Anja Nowak via Customer portal.

rationale: Aerosol goods are subject to strict handling and storage rules; the recipient's request to forward or leave with a neighbor is not permissible under carrier policy. The desk must not make a safety decision or agree to non-compliant handling. The right move routes to the safety and routing teams who own those decisions, acknowledging the facility's genuine constraint and the recipient's preference without committing to either option.
